name: Nile River
description: Widely regarded as the longest river in the world, flowing northwards through northeastern Africa to empty into the Mediterranean Sea. The primary water source of Egypt and Sudan, sustaining civilizations since ancient times.

name: Amazon River
description: The largest river by discharge volume in the world, holding greater discharge than the next seven largest rivers combined. It drains the Amazon Basin, the world's largest drainage basin covering about 40% of South America.

name: Yangtze River
description: The longest river in Asia and the third-longest in the world. It flows entirely within China, originating in the Tanggula Mountains on the Tibetan Plateau and emptying into the East China Sea at Shanghai. Home to the Three Gorges Dam.

name: Mississippi-Missouri River System
description: The chief river system of North America, draining all or parts of 32 U.S. states and two Canadian provinces. The Mississippi proper begins at Lake Itasca in Minnesota and enters the Gulf of Mexico south of New Orleans.

name: Danube River
description: Europe's second-longest river after the Volga. It flows through or borders 10 countries, more than any other river in the world, passing through major capitals: Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest, and Belgrade.

name: Volga River
description: The longest river in Europe and the national river of Russia, flowing through western Russia and emptying into the Caspian Sea. Eleven of the twenty largest Russian cities, including Moscow's surrounding waterways, lie in its drainage basin.

name: Ganges River
description: A sacred trans-boundary river in India and Bangladesh. Originating in the western Himalayas at the Gangotri Glacier, it flows through the Gangetic Plain of India and joins the Brahmaputra in Bangladesh before entering the Bay of Bengal.

name: Rhine River
description: One of the major European rivers, originating in southeastern Swiss Alps and forming a key commercial transport artery through central Europe into the North Sea at Rotterdam.

name: Congo River
description: The second-longest river in Africa and the world's deepest recorded river (depths over 220 meters). It is the only major river to cross the equator twice.

name: Mekong River
description: A trans-boundary river in East and Southeast Asia, vital for agricultural irrigation, fisheries, and transportation across the Indochinese Peninsula.
